忙忙叨叨一上午，吃过午饭王野就在办公室开始摆烂。随着办公室的人多，曹强进门就站在王野旁边：“哥，抓特务为什么不带着我？”

“尽说屁话，你才刚来几天呀，怎么带你去。再说了你爹让你来是学功夫的，不是让你立功的。万一有个啥，你爹就你一个儿子，你还让你爹活不活了？”

曹强气呼呼的站在边上也不说话。王野看着这个傻大个也是没办法：“好了，下次一定带你行了吧？”

曹强听了这话咧着大嘴嘿嘿傻笑。王野也是没办法，有这么一个傻兄弟也是他自找的。王野看着曹强那傻样一拍脑门：“咳，造孽呀。”

冯大力也凑了过来：“小野，你那么厉害也教教我呗。”

其他人听见冯大力这么问全都围了过来七嘴八舌的说道：“还有我，还有我。”

王野看着这群人也是无语了，就连石磊这个生性懦弱的小子都过来了。

“各位哥哥，不是我不教你们。是条件不允许呀，都说穷文富武。不是一句空话，练武需要的东西太多了。”

“不说别的就是每天的吃食就不是一般人可以承受的，我是会打猎才能勉强够吃，这曹强你们也知道怎么回事儿。”

众人想了一下也没毛病现在饭都吃不饱还练武，别开玩笑了。

王野解释道：“其实现在四九城有功夫的挺多的。之所以不练了跟吃不饱肚子有很大关系，不过大家有时间可以去靶场看我教曹强，虽然学不精，但是学点技巧还是可以的。”

王野并不是忽悠大家，练武真是一个很烧钱的事情。王野虽然练功不久，现在不论是人参药丸，还是虎骨药浴，再加上王野空间里一锅锅的卤肉。这都是一张张的大黑十呀。

众人得到王野的允许也很高兴，前两天不是他们不想去。只是怕有什么禁忌才一直忍着。在早些年偷学被人家抓到轻则一顿毒打，重则要命。

众人回到自己的座位摸鱼去了，王野拿出医书开始看了起来。不知过了多久一个中年同事开门叫到：“小野，赵叔叫你和科长过去。”王野道了声谢就出门去叫吴志强了。

门卫室赵爷爷正在陪着一个老头聊天，王野一进门就认出了这个老头。这是自己师妹杨璎珞的邻居。果然在老人身后站着小师妹和他的弟弟。

小姑娘见到王野马上给予一个灿烂的笑容。王野上前先跟两位老人打了个招呼，半蹲下问小姑娘：“小璎，弟弟的病好了吗？”

杨璎珞露出甜甜的微笑：“谢谢师兄，弟弟的病好了，昨天就出院了。”

赵爷爷介绍道：“志强，这是我给你收的小徒弟，你来认识一下。她叫杨璎珞，小璎这就是你师父吴志强。”

杨璎珞怯生生的叫了声师父。吴志强看看小姑娘，看看赵爷爷半天说不出话来。

赵爷爷一脸不高兴：“哑巴啦，人家小姑娘叫你师父呢。”

吴志强这才赶紧答应，然后委屈巴巴的问赵爷爷：“师父，我啥时候可以自己收个徒弟？”

赵爷爷一点不给面子：“你会收徒弟吗？”

吴志强一脸不服气：“我怎么不会了，怎么说我原来也是个小高手。”

赵爷爷面露不屑：“你是个高手有屁用呀，你看的出谁有练武的资质吗？”

吴志强强词夺理道：“师父你也没教我呀？”

After busy chatting all morning, Wang Ye started messing around in the office after lunch.As there were more people in the office, Cao Qiang walked in and stood next to Wang Ye: "Brother, why didn't you take me with you to catch the spy?"

"You're talking nonsense, you've only been here a few days, how can I take you there? Besides, your father asked you to come here to learn kung fu, not to make meritorious deeds. If anything happens, your father is only your son, how can you let your father live?"

Cao Qiang stood aside angrily and said nothing.Wang Ye looked at this silly big man and had no choice but to say: "Okay, I will take you with me next time, right?"

Cao Qiang grinned widely after hearing this.Wang Ye couldn't help it. He asked for such a stupid brother.Wang Ye looked at Cao Qiang's stupid look and slapped his forehead: "Ahem, what a sin."

Feng Dali also came over: "Xiaoye, you are so good, why don't you teach me."

When the others heard Feng Dali's question, they all gathered around and said, "There's me, there's me."

Wang Ye was speechless looking at this group of people. Even Shi Lei, a cowardly boy, came over.

"Brothers, it's not that I don't teach you. It's just that the conditions don't allow it. They say that the poor are poor in literature and rich in martial arts. It's not an empty talk, there are too many things needed to practice martial arts."

"If nothing else, the daily food cannot be afforded by ordinary people. I have to hunt to survive. You guys also know what's going on with Cao Qiang."

After everyone thought about it, there was nothing wrong with them. Now they are practicing martial arts even if they don't have enough to eat. Stop joking.

Wang Ye explained: "Actually, there are quite a lot of people in Sijiu City who are good at kung fu now. The reason why they stopped practicing has a lot to do with not having enough food. However, if you have time, you can go to the shooting range to watch me teach Cao Qiang. Although you are not good at it, you can still learn some skills."

Wang Ye is not fooling everyone, practicing martial arts is really a very expensive thing.Although Wang Ye has been practicing martial arts for a short time, now he can take ginseng pills, tiger bone medicinal baths, or pots of braised pork in Wang Ye’s space.These are all big black tens.

Everyone was very happy to get Wang Ye's permission. It wasn't that they didn't want to go two days ago.I just endured it because I was afraid of any taboos.In the early years, if he was caught cheating on his studies, he would be beaten severely, and in the worst case, he would be killed.

Everyone returned to their seats to fish. Wang Ye took out a medical book and started reading.I don't know how long it took for a middle-aged colleague to open the door and call: "Xiaoye, Uncle Zhao asked you and the section chief to come over." Wang Ye thanked him and went out to call Wu Zhiqiang.

Grandpa Zhao was chatting with an old man in the guard room. Wang Ye recognized the old man as soon as he entered the door.This is the neighbor of his junior sister Yang Yingluo.Sure enough, behind the old man stood the junior sister and his younger brother.

The little girl gave Wang Yeye a bright smile when she saw him.Wang Ye stepped forward and said hello to the two old men, then squatted down and asked the little girl: "Xiaoying, is my brother's illness cured?"

Yang Yingluo smiled sweetly: "Thank you, senior brother. My brother's illness has recovered and he was discharged from the hospital yesterday."

Grandpa Zhao introduced: "Zhiqiang, this is the little apprentice I have accepted for you. Come and get to know her. Her name is Yang Yingluo. Xiaoying, this is your master Wu Zhiqiang."

Yang Yingluo timidly called Master.Wu Zhiqiang looked at the little girl and saw that Grandpa Zhao was speechless for a long time.

Grandpa Zhao looked unhappy: "You are mute. This little girl calls you Master."

Wu Zhiqiang quickly agreed, and then asked Grandpa Zhao aggrievedly: "Master, when can I accept a disciple by myself?"

Grandpa Zhao didn't give any face at all: "Will you accept a disciple?"

Wu Zhiqiang looked unconvinced: "Why can't I do it anymore? After all, I am also a little master."

Grandpa Zhao showed disdain on his face: "You are a master of no use. Can you tell who has the qualifications to practice martial arts?"

Wu Zhiqiang said eloquently: "Master, you didn't teach me anything?"
